title: # Back up the AXP streaming stack code to private GitHub repos + fix the :3200 flap (Brett, Nov 1 ~…
asked: # Back up the AXP streaming stack code to private GitHub repos + fix the :3200 flap (Brett, Nov 1 ~3:30 AM) Read /opt/axf/CLAUDE.md and _claude/shared/rules/RULES.md first. Opus, one session. Never print secrets. Do NOT view, copy or commit any media, uploads, user content or database data. Context (read-only check xchat-check, report in /root/axf-builds/xchat-check/xchat-check.log): Brett's adult streaming app is xchat.amberxai.com. Its code lives ONLY on this server, with no GitHub home: - /opt/amberx/xchat (Next.js app + deploy/ compose; not a git repo) - containers axp-xchat, axp-xchat-media - /opt/axp-devstudio (dev studio, not a git repo) - container axp-devstudio - /opt/axp-demo (git repo, no commits, no remote) - container axp-demo + axp-demo-api ## 1. Backup to PRIVATE repos under MossesX - Repos: MossesX/axp-xchat, MossesX/axp-devstudio, MossesX/axp-demo. All PRIVATE. Create them with `gh repo create MossesX/<name> --private` (gh is logged in). If creation is refused (the fine-grained token may lack Administration: write), do NOT work around it: put a red console banner item 'Create 3 private repos for the AXP backup' with exact steps (github.com/new, names, Private, no README) and a one-click re-run, and stop after step 2 below. - For each folder: work on a COPY (rsync to /root/axp-backup/<name>, never git-init or touch the live folder; for /opt/axp-demo use a fresh clone/copy too). Write a strict .gitignore first: node_modules, .next, dist, build, .env*, *.pem, *.key, *.crt, secrets*, *.sqlite*, *.db, dumps, backups, uploads/, media/, recordings/, storage/, data/, logs, *.mp4/*.webm/*.mov/*.jpg/*.png over 1 MB unless clearly UI assets in public/. - Secret scan BEFORE the first commit (gitleaks via docker, or trufflehog; fallback: grep for key/token/password/secret patterns). Any hit: move that value out (keep it only on the server), commit a `.env.example` with placeholder names instead. Re-scan until clean. Also check the compose files for inline secrets. - Commit (author Claude, message 'Backup of <name> from the VPS, Nov 1 2026'), push to main of the private repo. Size check: refuse to push if the repo is > 200 MB and report what's big. - Add a nightly backup: cron or systemd timer on the server that rsyncs each live folder to its backup copy (same excludes), re-runs the secret scan, commits and pushes only if something changed; failures go to the console banner. Document it in /opt/axf install_steps (new part 'AXP backup') via a normal commit + push on AmberX-AXF. ## 2. Fix the :3200 flap The demo's nginx resolves axp-devstudio to IPv6 first, but the devstudio listens IPv4 only (HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0) -> intermittent 'connection refused' on /studio/. Preferred, least risky fix: in the axp-demo nginx config, add `resolver 127.0.0.11 ipv6=off valid=30s;` and use a variable upstream (or point at the IPv4 name) so it only uses IPv4. Back up the config file first, `nginx -t` inside the container, then `nginx -s reload` (no container restart). Verify: 20 requests to https://demo.amberxai.com/studio/ all return the same non-5xx status, and no new 'connection refused' lines in the demo log for 2 minutes. If nginx -t fails, restore the backup and report. Do NOT restart axp-xchat, xchat-media, coturn or the database. ## Report Plain English at /root/axp-backup/REPORT.md and print it: repos created (links), what was excluded, secret-scan results (counts and files, never values), sizes, nightly backup schedule, the flap fix with before/after error counts, anything that needs Brett. Watch live: Brett can watch the screen you are changing hot-render in the console. Whenever you start work on a screen or element, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "<what you are changing>"` (apps: console-web, axhub-web, amberx-droid, patches-web, walkthrough-studio, demo, framework, console, axhub-android, voicevault).

result.summary: AXP backups built + committed locally (gitleaks clean), repo creation refused by token -> banner + auto-finish timer; :3200 flap fixed (nginx IPv4-only resolver), 0 refused after. Report /root/axp-backup/REPORT.md
